name: tickethub-api
description: TicketHub API: API Gateway y servicios Identity, Catalog, Inventory, Purchase y Ticket

scripts.mock: npm run mock:build && prism mock -p 4010 mock/tickethub.openapi.json
scripts.test: docker compose exec -T identity-service npm run create-admin --silent && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait catalog-service inventory-sweep inventory-lazy inventory-nocatalog && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml --profile test run --rm --use-aliases tests; status=$?; docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml rm -sf inventory-sweep inventory-lazy inventory-nocatalog; docker compose up -d --wait catalog-service; exit $status
